qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Sovereign monopoly/duopoly in nuclear-powered submarines (Electric Boat) and Tier-1 surface combatants (Bath Iron Works) anchored by physically unreplicable nuclear-certified coastal shipyards and deep defense security clearances. Contractual Economic Price Adjustment (EPA) clauses on defense programs pass through inflation, while Gulfstream commands strong list-price realization across ultra-long-range business aviation. Historical GAAP ROIC consistently exceeds the 12% hurdle (13.0% in 2024, 13.7% in 2025; 10-year average ~13-14%).
qualitative.note: Passes all 6 gates. Sovereign defense infrastructure prime with a legal and physical monopoly in US Navy nuclear ballistic missile submarines (Columbia-class) and premier Tier-1 surface combatants, complemented by ultra-long-range business aviation (Gulfstream G700/G800) and defense IT (GDIT). Structural beneficiary of enduring geopolitical realignment and NATO/AUKUS rearmament. Flawless capital allocation under Outsider CEO Phebe Novakovic. Balance sheet is in fortress condition with net debt at 1.35x net income, interest coverage of 17.1x, and multi-year free cash flow conversion of ~98%. [5-10Y g: naval submarine volume 3.5% + Gulfstream G700/G800 ramp 2.5% + defense IT pricing and mix 1.0% - working capital drag 0.5% + net share repurchases 1.0%]
qualitative.evidence: Multi-cycle GAAP ROIC is 13.0%-13.7% (tangible/operating ROIC >18%). Peak-to-peak EPS compounding is intact, rising from $11.00 in 2020 to $12.19 in 2022, $13.75 in 2024, and ~$15.30 in 2025. Cumulative Free Cash Flow from 2020 to 2024 was $16.67B on Net Income of $16.91B (98.6% conversion), and reached ~$4.0B in 2025 (94.5% conversion) as post-FAA certification deliveries of the Gulfstream G700 liquidated inventory working capital. Total debt of $8.01B against $2.33B cash yields net debt of $5.68B, or 1.35x FY2025 Net Income ($4.21B). 2025 Operating Income was $5.36B against net interest of $314M (17.1x interest coverage). Backlog stands at a record $93B+.
